name: page-lab
description: Author Violentmonkey userscripts and diagnose live pages from one place — a measure-before-you-select method, a two-way element picker driven over the Chrome DevTools Protocol, a config-driven redesign acceptance runner that injects at document-start across real navigations and exercises the result with trusted events, performance/network/console diagnosis, and a Greasy Fork readiness linter, and a multi-agent method for redesigning a whole site, and a supervised-driving mode in which an agent drives the operator's Chromium behind a take-over-with-Esc overlay and hands control to the operator for logins, captchas and payments without stealing their window.
